description: This script detects unresolved Git merge conflict markers in tracked files within a project. It lists files, scans for conflict markers, and reports any unmerged conflicts to aid in code cleanup.

methods.name: isBinaryBuffer
methods.description: Checks if the provided buffer contains a null byte, indicating a binary file.

methods.name: findConflictMarkerLines
methods.description: Splits content into lines and finds the line numbers where merge conflict markers are present.

methods.name: listTrackedFiles
methods.description: Uses git to list all tracked files in the current repository.

methods.name: findConflictMarkersInFiles
methods.description: Iterates over given files, reads their content, and identifies those containing conflict markers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that executes the conflict marker scanning process and reports violations.
